CloneCloud is an elastic system that enables mobile applications to seamlessly migrate part of their computation from the mobile device to a clone running in the computational cloud.

we present CloneCloud, a novel system that automatically transforms unmodified mobile applications into elastic applications that can seamlessly execute part of their execution on the mobile device and part of it on device clones in a computational cloud, with the objective of optimizing the execution time and energy spent on the device.

we have designed a system, CloneCloud, to off load computation from mobile devices to the cloud and that it can help applications achieve as much a 20x speedup and a 20x decrease in energy consumption.

the design and implementation a system that enables mobile devices to benefit from cloud computing.

the problem of how to enable the seamless integration of mobile applications and computational clouds, and how to enable mobile applications to exploit the computational power and energy efficiency of clouds.
the design and implementation CloneCloud, a new system that automatically partitions applications running on mobile devices and executes them on clones in computational clouds.

CloneCloud is a system that enables mobile applications running in virtual machines on a mobile device to offload part of their execution to a clone in the cloud.
CloneCloud can be used to offload mobile applications to the cloud, which in turn can be used to speed up the execution and reduce the energy consumption.
CloneCloud is a novel system that can automatically partition and off load applications from a mobile device to a cloud for improved execution time and energy.

we are able to achieve the best of both worlds.
we present a system to transparently offload computation to the cloud.

mobile applications are amenable to elastic execution, and can benefit from offloading to computational clouds.
the cloud is an important resource for mobile applications and that it is important to provide a flexible and transparent way for mobile applications to benefit automatically from the cloud.
